name: Plymouth and South West Devon Joint Local Plan
organisation-name: Plymouth City Council, South Hams District Council, West Devon Borough Council

housing-numbers.notes: Plymouth Policy Area includes Plymouth administrative area plus urban fringe. Committed housing includes completions 2014-17 (2,705), under construction (901), and outstanding commitments (8,523). Also includes allowance for student HMO release (397) and demolitions (-872).

housing-numbers.organisation-name: Thriving Towns and Villages Policy Area
housing-numbers.notes: Covers rural South Hams and West Devon areas. Committed housing includes completions 2014-17 (1,394) and under construction (371). Broad locations housing represents Sustainable Villages allowance for neighbourhood plan delivery.
